concepts.gloss_en: the spirit/breath of life (of holiness) — the ruach-chaim that is erech apayim, sustains and completes all lack (LM 1:8)

reason_for_human: All 16 occurrences are within LM 1:8 and refer to the identical theological term — the spirit of life (ruach-chaim) that is erech apayim, completes lack, and overcomes the wicked. The article difference (רוח חיים / הרוח־חיים / רוח החיים) is mere inflectional/article variation, not archetype-vs-generic: note occ:2952 (רוח חיים) and occ:2691 (רוח החיים) both carry the exact same qualifier 'דקדושה' for the same idea. This is one word/one concept, so I merged the round-1 split.
